# appdynamics_user (Data Source)

Retrieves the details of a specific AppDynamics RBAC user, looked up by either user_id or name (exactly one must be set).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up by ID:
data "appdynamics_user" "by_id" {
  user_id = 3567
}

# ...or by name (exactly one of user_id / name must be set):
data "appdynamics_user" "by_name" {
  name = "jdoe"
}

output "jdoe_display_name" {
  value = data.appdynamics_user.by_name.display_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Login username of the user to retrieve. Exactly one of user_id or name must be set.
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the user to retrieve. Exactly one of user_id or name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String)
- `security_provider_type` (String)
